info.title: Solace PubSub+ Universal API
info.description: Solace PubSub+ Cloud provides managed event broker services, Event Portal resources, platform administration, API tokens, billing usage, and related Solace Cloud operations through REST APIs.

get.description: Retrieves an API token from Solace PubSub+.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Unique Solace Cloud API token identifier.

schema.description: Unique Solace Cloud API token identifier.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

permissions.description: Permission identifiers assigned to the token.

resourceAssignments.description: Resource assignments attached to the token.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
